prior: Y079-Y082 demonstrated bounded successful synthetic matching and observation timing, but no evidence of an improvement to retained-state decision-making. Test smallest zero-extra-capacity development-trained fixed preference policy first.
hypothesis: Can development-only selection among frozen sham, full and quorum2 retained-preference policies improve heldout physical matching mistakes over fixed quorum2 without added 7-active/9-retained memory, public reads, or collateral churn?
freeze: Use exact Y082 public sensor/decoder, two swap pairs, steady/onset3/onset7, four affine families, seven active and <=9 retained, 10 public reads. Train on never-heldout development seeds 16128..16135, all policies using evaluator truth only during development for a frozen objective: 100*mismatches+physical_churn+0.01*search_calls, deterministic tie-break. Freeze one policy for prospective heldout 16160..16175; compare all three policies there without using heldout truth to select/alter policy.
primary: DEV_SELECTED_RETENTION_POLICY_GENERALIZED iff selected !=quorum2, >=5% fewer total mismatch episodes than quorum2, no per-case (pair/regime) group regression, total churn <=105% quorum2, steady null 0. PARTIAL_RETENTION_POLICY_GAIN_OR_COST iff lower overall mismatch without all controls. NO_RETENTION_POLICY_GAIN otherwise. RETENTION_NULL_SAFETY_FAILURE dominates. Archive 384 matched records each with 3 policy arms and independent count sums.
controls: Only development data selects policy, no first-use tuning, no evaluator truth to candidate

Original evidence custody before scoring assertions, final full pytest and separate archive numerical review
